name: Bethlehem
line: Bethlehem is a town in Judah, also called Ephrath, near where Rachel was buried, where David's story began, and where a ruler for Israel was to come from.

moments.title: Rachel is buried
moments.text: Rachel died on the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem, and was buried there on the way. Jacob set up a pillar on her grave.

moments.title: Naomi and Ruth arrive
moments.text: Naomi came back from Moab with her daughter-in-law Ruth. They arrived in Bethlehem at the start of the barley harvest.

moments.title: Samuel visits Jesse
moments.text: Samuel did what the LORD had said and went to Bethlehem. The elders trembled and asked if he came in peace, and he said he came to sacrifice to the LORD.

moments.title: Water from the well
moments.text: David longed for water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem. Three mighty men broke through the Philistine camp to get it, but David poured it out to the LORD.

moments.title: Jesus is born in Bethlehem
moments.text: Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod. The prophet had written that a ruler who would shepherd God's people Israel would come out of Bethlehem.
